svg.title: MediaLog — Fire button symbol
svg.desc: A ball-top joystick in red, white and yellow is drawn on the attribute grid of an 8-bit home computer: colour changes only at cell edges, over a chunky blue plasma inside a red border. Primary brand colour #18223a, plain MediaLog wordmark. Pixels stay fine while colour is set per 8 × 8 cell, so the stick and ball share inks the way the hardware forces; Two yellow raster stripes run into the border; saturated reds and yellows replace the neon cyan and magenta of the original palette.
